phase: Prospective Monetary Confirmation — Household Housing Lending Pass-Through
purpose: Prospectively confirm or fail to confirm the already frozen household-housing delta-policy candidate using only future policy-rate events and subsequently published MIR observations, without refitting, respecifying, peeking at reserved response values, or treating elapsed time/non-event months as identifying evidence.

prospective_data_boundary.policy_event_definition: A non-zero change in the BNR policy rate decided by the NBR Board and effective within a calendar month.
prospective_data_boundary.identifying_month_definition: A calendar month in the reserved window for which policy[t]-policy[t-1] is non-zero.
prospective_data_boundary.non_event_months: May be retained for chronology and state continuity but provide zero model-vs-persistence discrimination for the frozen delta-policy form and therefore do not count toward the formal identifying-event minimum.
prospective_data_boundary.response_mapping: For a policy change in month t, the contemporaneous candidate is evaluated against the MIR household-housing observation for the same calendar month t, using the prior month lending rate and the frozen beta.

ECB_MIR_release_calendar.rule: The calendar controls when a response month may first be inspected; an early or delayed provider publication must be recorded explicitly rather than silently changing the gate.

stage_0_wait_for_event.condition: No non-zero BNR policy-rate event has occurred in the reserved prospective window.
allowed_actions: check policy decisions and publication calendars
verify that frozen model artifacts are unchanged

stage_1_first_event_diagnostic.trigger: First non-zero policy-rate event in the reserved prospective window and official publication of the same-month MIR response.
stage_1_first_event_diagnostic.response_access: Open only the event-month MIR response and the minimum prior-month value needed to compute the frozen one-step prediction if that prior-month value was not already legitimately observed.
stage_1_first_event_diagnostic.rule: One event can falsify bookkeeping or reveal gross misspecification but cannot validate the mechanism.

stage_2_accumulate_events.rule: Repeat the frozen first-event procedure for each later non-zero policy-rate event. Do not refit or change candidate/baseline definitions.

metrics: bias actual-minus-predicted on identifying event months
RMSE improvement versus persistence on identifying event months
plus/minus 10 percent frozen-beta sensitivity on identifying event months

gates.sensitivity_rule: ±10% perturbation of frozen beta must not more than double event-conditioned RMSE relative to the unperturbed frozen candidate.

stage_3_formal_confirmation.pass_rule: Every formal-confirmation gate must pass. Passing supports prospective predictive confirmation within the tested household-housing monthly boundary; it does not establish causal identification and does not by itself activate behavioural closure.
stage_3_formal_confirmation.fail_rule: Failure leaves the current form unvalidated. Any respecification or refit requires a new preregistered validation cycle and may not reuse the failed confirmation observations as an independent holdout.
